comparisons.name: search-light
comparisons.description: The search field over the blurred desktop, Aqua. The placeholder is masked: it is text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms. The background is painted by the example as measured; the magnifier is the library's own drawing.

comparisons.name: search-dark
comparisons.description: The search field over the blurred desktop, Dark Aqua, placeholder masked as in search-light.

comparisons.name: pages-light
comparisons.description: The two page dots, first page current, Aqua. Nothing is masked; the background is painted by the example as measured.

comparisons.name: pages-dark
comparisons.description: The two page dots, first page current, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: scrim-light
comparisons.description: Launchpad over a flat mid grey, Aqua: the scrim, and the search field's fill and border over it.

pixels.note: --mac-launchpad-scrim, 44% of #1c1c1c over #808080 (blur and saturation leave a flat grey unchanged); the tint is the spec's fit, computed from measured pixels
--mac-launchpad-search-fill, 6.5% white over the scrim's #545454; alpha computed from Launchpad @ 1500,60 over 1500,40
--mac-launchpad-search-border, 21% white over #545454, 1 pt wide; alpha computed from Launchpad @ 1500,50

comparisons.name: keyboard-light
comparisons.description: Arrow Down from the freshly opened Launchpad focuses the first app, Aqua: focus ring and plate around its icon box. Inferred; no screenshot shows keyboard focus in Launchpad.

pixels.note: --mac-focus-ring-color at 50% over the scrim's #545454, 3 pt outside the 112 pt icon box (inferred)
--mac-launchpad-highlight, 20% white over #545454, inside the icon box beside the icon (inferred)

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: Mouse button held on an app, Aqua: its icon is darkened by half. Inferred (spec: icon pressed).
